title: CreNum - Edition numerique de la Chronique francaise de Guillaume Cretin
notes: CreNum is the ELAN (Grenoble) digital XML-TEI edition of Guillaume Crétin's Chronique française (five books, 1515 edition), edited by Antoine Brix and Ellen Delvallée with the ELAN team. The edition is published at crenum.elan-numerique.fr; the TEI sources are in the project's GitLab repository (gricad-gitlab.univ-grenoble-alpes.fr/elan/crenum), which shows a bot-check page to browsers. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
institution: ELAN / UMR Litt&Arts (CNRS / Universite Grenoble Alpes)
